info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Network Management API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Connectivity tests are stored test definitions only: no reachability analysis or probing runs, so reachabilityDetails, returnReachabilityDetails and probingDetails stay absent and rerun is not implemented. Source and destination endpoints are recorded as given and not resolved. VPC Flow Logs configurations and network monitoring providers are not implemented. Long-running operations complete synchronously and remain readable through operations.get/list.
info.title: Network Intelligence Center (Network Management) (simulator catalog)
